reason: common/src/main/java/org/keycloak/common/crypto/CryptoProvider.java:44 declares `int order();` with no default, and CryptoIntegration.java:57 sorts ServiceLoader-discovered providers with `Comparator.comparingInt(CryptoProvider::order)`, so an external implementation no longer compiles.
